text:
Process: independent execution unit with separate memory space. Thread: lightweight execution unit within a process, sharing memory space with other threads in same process.

| Difference | Process | Thread |
|------------|---------|--------|
| Memory | Separate address space | Shared memory space |
| Overhead | High | Low |
| Creation | Expensive | Cheap |
| Communication | IPC (pipes, sockets) | Shared variables |
| Isolation | Strong | Weak |
